'''Micah White MAXIMUM CARNAGE SVT''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Micah White]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13961">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13961 MAXIMUM CARNAGE SVT], DeckTech (Micah "ObiVader" White, 23 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13961/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13961/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018043629/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13961/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Micah White]]
* '''Published:''' 23 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''MAXIMUM CARNAGE SVT''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HD White DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' I fixed a few stupid mistakes, added choice characters and made it better. I think I got a keeper here.

== Original post ==

'''MAXIMUM CARNAGE SVT'''
* '''Author:''' Micah "ObiVader" White
* '''Published:''' February 23, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' I fixed a few stupid mistakes, added choice characters and made it better. I think I got a keeper here.

=== Strategy ===

Same as last time, only better.  Look at the interrupt choices and let me know what to change. I will only change this one more time after this, unless I see any drastic changes. Thanks again, and please rate fairly.

-Micah 'ObiVader' White
